summary: Iteration 8 — Desktop admin (auth + leads inbox + branding + embed) tested end-to-end on backend (24 pytest, 100% pass) and frontend (desktop 1366x860 + mobile 390x844). All new testIDs render; wrong password shows 'Invalid email or password'; lockout kicks in after 5 fails on a fake email; lead patch adds system note; manual notes persist; branding save returns live preview; embed snippet references /api/embed.js; Pricing nav auto-unlocks /merchant via Bearer token (no PIN prompt). Mobile /admin renders top bar + horizontal nav chips; home shows 'GADO JEWELLERS' brand name and 'For jewelers · Store admin' link; /build?embed=1 loads. Branding restored to Gado Jewellers / #C5A059 / #1A1A18 / #FCFCFA / playfair / satoshi. No deprecated Expo packages or React Native issues detected.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.py:89,106 — update_lead and add_note declare `admin: dict = Depends(get_current_admin)` even though the router already has `dependencies=[Depends(get_current_admin)]`. FastAPI will inject it twice (per-request). Harmless because admin_from_token is a single mongo lookup, but the duplication is wasteful.
dashboard.py:66 — list_leads caps at 500 with no pagination/skip. Fine today but will silently drop older leads once the inbox grows beyond 500.
dashboard.py:49 — _oid raises 404 for a non-ObjectId lead id; good UX, but note that lead ids returned to the client are stringified ObjectIds (admin UI should never see UUIDs here).

server.py:396 — create_quote: for a product lead, image is only attached when BOTH tryon_id AND product_id resolve to a matching tryon row. If someone submits only render_url for a product lead it is ignored (by design, since render belongs to designs). Behaviour is correct but under-documented.

auth.py:109 — DUMMY_HASH check is correct timing-attack defence; however, the lockout window is enforced only via login_attempts; a sophisticated attacker rotating emails can bypass per-ip rate limiting (none exists on /api/auth/login). Consider adding IP-based throttling similar to /api/admin.

frontend index.tsx admin leads filter chips sit inside a horizontal ScrollView — Playwright is_visible returned False for all leads-filter-* even though screenshot confirms they render. Not a bug, just a testing gotcha for future agents (use query_selector/count instead of is_visible).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_* leads (one design, one product/embed) + 1 playwright-added lead via UI. Branding restored to Gado defaults after branding tests. 1 fake-email lockout record left in db.login_attempts (will auto-expire via TTL index on locked_until).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin desktop tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_dashboard.py. The lockout test uses a random TEST_lock_*@example.com (never locks the real admin). Branding tests end with a restore step to Gado defaults — keep that pattern. Playwright is_visible is unreliable for RN horizontal ScrollView children; use query_selector or .count() for leads-filter-*. The try-on enquiry UI flow (try-on-enquire-button → form → success) was verified by code inspection only to avoid a second ~20s AI call this iteration; the quotes endpoint path accepting tryon_id/product_id/source=embed is covered by pytest.
